Based on the provided information, the HepaProtect vaccine has an efficacy of 95% in preventing Hepatitis B infection specifically for healthy individuals aged 18 to 55. It is generally well tolerated, but it is not suitable for individuals with a history of severe allergies to yeast or any of the vaccine components, who should avoid it. The text does not provide efficacy data or suitability information for age groups outside the 18-55 range or for individuals with other health conditions.
